subject: Request: Short runway support while ClearWave PO completes
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearwave.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.ai
Date: 2026-08-23 09:12 -07:00
Subject: Request: Short runway support while ClearWave PO completes

Hi Elena —

Quick follow from our demo last week. The team is making good progress integrating the runtime, and your product folks hit a couple of production tests that look promising. I heard from your procurement thread that the PO has made it to finance but is sitting on one last vendor approval item.

Given the momentum, would ClearWave be open to a short runway top-up from our side so you don’t lose the evaluation momentum while the PO clears? Typical options we do here are a small sandbox token grant (7 days) or a temporary extension of the trial environment. No changes to commercial terms — this is just to keep the proof-of-concept live while paperwork finishes.

If that sounds good, I can get a 7-day sandbox top-up approved within the day. If procurement needs a draft PO to speed routing, I attached a PO draft your team can use.

Thanks, and cc’ing Kimberly from Revenue Ops for approval on the top-up flow.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachment: clearwave_po_draft.pdf
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearwave.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwave.ai
Date: 2026-08-23 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short runway support while ClearWave PO completes

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for checking in. We really like what we saw in the demo; engineering is aligned. The snag is internal: the vendor risk questionnaire needs one additional field answered about data retention policies and our CFO is waiting on legal sign-off. I pushed the questionnaire this morning but it may not move until Monday.

A 7-day top-up would be extremely helpful — it gives us time to run two additional integration tests and share results with the stakeholders. Procurement is copied; if you can provide a small temporary credit and the PO draft that would keep things moving.

Elena
Director of Product, ClearWave.ai
elena.morales@clearwave.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24 08:46 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short runway support while ClearWave PO completes

Marcus —

I reviewed the usage snapshot you attached (usage_snapshot-aug-week1.csv) and the ask looks within our short-term credit policy for inbound trials. Approving a 7-day sandbox token grant (equivalent to $1,250 in covered usage) is fine.

Two small asks: please confirm the start/end timestamps for the grant and add a line item to the HubSpot deal noting this is a non-recurring evaluation top-up so finance has the context when the PO lands. I’ve penciled this approval into the deal record.

Kimberly
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, procurement@clearwave.ai, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-26 14:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short runway support while ClearWave PO completes

Great — thanks Kim. Elena — we’ll apply a 7-day sandbox top-up starting 2026-08-27 00:00 PDT through 2026-09-03 00:00 PDT. The grant is limited to evaluation usage and will not auto-convert to a committed contract. I’ve added a note to the HubSpot deal and attached the PO draft again for procurement.

If procurement needs anything else to expedite the PO, happy to hop on a short call Monday with your legal/finance.

Thanks — looking forward to the next integration results.

—Marcus
Attachment: clearwave_po_draft.pdf
